alignment_check.scope: All 955 verse display rows read in paired source-English alignment; repeated clauses, names, numbers, insults and source defects checked. No independent expert review.

notes.manas-2010:p0139:b002:l015: Visible Алтайдан (from Altai) retained despite surrounding exile-to-Altai narrative; no harmonization.
notes.manas-2010:p0139:b002:l019: At-death birth formula rendered at death’s door; metaphor for late-desired birth, no literal historical chronology asserted.
notes.manas-2010:p0139:b002:l020: туйгун rendered goshawk; precise falconry age/color classification remains provisional.
notes.manas-2010:p0139:b002:l029: барчын female falcon retained, including female comparison for male child.
notes.manas-2010:p0139:b002:l035: Бейпай interpreted as uproar; exact spelling/lexeme uncertain in digital witness.
notes.manas-2010:p0139:b002:l042: Subject we supplied contextually for passive raided/scattered phrase.
notes.manas-2010:p0140:b002:l002: сан түмөн is indefinite multitude here; no invented exact arithmetic.
notes.manas-2010:p0140:b002:l006: Какшап жүрүп rendered repeated lamenting; no distinct journey inferred.
notes.manas-2010:p0140:b002:l016: болтурат visibly anomalous; fulfill his wishes is contextual, not a verified correction.
notes.manas-2010:p0140:b002:l021: Fat on yurt covering retained as prosperity image, not modernized into wealth alone.
notes.manas-2010:p0140:b002:l028: English optative may expresses prophetic assurance; source could be future will.
notes.manas-2010:p0140:b002:l029: Greed lines address Jakyp; continuation leads to Kyrgyz people in dative, return you to your people. Pronoun resolution corrected in alignment pass.
notes.manas-2010:p0140:b002:l046: мураа read inheritance, likely defective мурас; raw preserved.
notes.manas-2010:p0141:b002:l003: Упасы interpreted as fidelity/benefit in livestock contrast; uncertain spelling, no source emendation.
notes.manas-2010:p0141:b002:l008: жут is livestock-killing weather/famine disaster, not generic moral punishment.
notes.manas-2010:p0141:b002:l018: көк жал may mean gray-maned/wolf-maned; gray wolf’s mane is provisional in supernatural birth description.
notes.manas-2010:p0141:b002:l021: чарайна has armor senses but also equals чарана, birth membrane/coating. Birth context selects latter, verified Yudakhin and Kyrgyz explanatory dictionaries: https://el-sozduk.kg/чарайна/.
notes.manas-2010:p0141:b002:l025: Twelve women retained exactly; earlier birth account has nine in one place, not harmonized.
notes.manas-2010:p0141:b002:l032: сүрүнөт interpreted as circumcision, variant/defective сүннөт; raw unchanged.
notes.manas-2010:p0141:b002:l039: Source shifts into third-person description of Chyyrdy inside her speech. Shift preserved, not assigned a newly invented narrator boundary.
notes.manas-2010:p0141:b002:l043: Кызыр standardized to established Kydyr; source spelling retained.
notes.manas-2010:p0141:b002:l047: His forehead follows third-person possessive чекесинен; child versus mother antecedent not secure, no claim of definitive resolution.
notes.manas-2010:p0142:b002:l013: Күмүрөй uncertain; strength of an army is contextual, requires expert lexical review.
notes.manas-2010:p0142:b002:l014: экөөлөйт literally makes two/joins as pair despite forty chiltens; join selected without changing forty.
notes.manas-2010:p0142:b002:l016: Twelve choro retained despite forty companions later; no reconciliation.
notes.manas-2010:p0142:b002:l025: калыйпа means caliph. Enter the caliph’s presence contextual for кирип. Dictionary parallel has Калыйпадан кат алган: https://el-sozduk.kg/калыйпа/.
notes.manas-2010:p0142:b002:l026: Visible бирге means together but dictionary parallel quotes Он эки пирге кол берген. Twelve spiritual guides is explicit contextual correction пирге, not silent source change. https://el-sozduk.kg/калыйпа/.
notes.manas-2010:p0142:b002:l027: zayypurush retained heroic epithet, illustrious/supremely distinguished in Yudakhin: https://el-sozduk.kg/зайыппуруш/.
notes.manas-2010:p0142:b002:l036: Lasso-pole formula retained literally; precise idiomatic construction remains unresolved.
notes.manas-2010:p0142:b002:l040: Shay retained as written. May be Shahi Mardan, Ali as heroes’ protector; dictionary supports Sh aymerden protection but not exact shortened identification. https://el-sozduk.kg/шай/.
notes.manas-2010:p0142:b002:l044: буй кыл means confound/distress, verified with matching white-deer formula in Yudakhin. https://el-sozduk.kg/буй/.
notes.manas-2010:p0143:b002:l006: Contrast explicitly distinguishes choro (retainers) and joro (companions); not collapsed to the same English term.
notes.manas-2010:p0143:b002:l008: кыркы counts forty champions, not forty ages; көй кашка is uncertain epithet, champions provisional.
notes.manas-2010:p0143:b002:l020: Ырымкай interpreted as infant, likely defective ымыркай; raw preserved.
notes.manas-2010:p0143:b002:l027: Алейки салам formula preserved despite unusual self-reference; no source normalization.
notes.manas-2010:p0143:b002:l031: Literal eye/self emphatic paradox retained, precise idiomatic sense unresolved.
notes.manas-2010:p0143:b002:l042: Negative болбосо retained as unless support comes from your child; connection to preceding livestock sentence is awkward in source.
notes.manas-2010:p0143:b002:l045: tynar retained falconry term, a prized hawk; no unsupported species identification.
notes.manas-2010:p0144:b002:l018: басташчу interpreted as contend with, possible defective башташчу; raw preserved.
notes.manas-2010:p0144:b002:l020: кара калмакты has unexpected accusative ending; apposition Black Kalmyk chosen contextually.
notes.manas-2010:p0144:b002:l022: айтты literally said; laid a burden is contextual interpretation of айтты салмакты, possibly defective артты.
notes.manas-2010:p0144:b002:l026: Visually wrapped display line continues as standalone санааңды at l027. Both original display-line IDs and separate English rows retained, lineation provisional.
notes.manas-2010:p0144:b002:l027: Continuation of l026, not an independently asserted oral verse line.
notes.manas-2010:p0144:b002:l032: Negative hesitate construction retained; implication Oshpur would show no mercy, not exoneration.
notes.manas-2010:p0144:b002:l036: jangjung retained historical military title; no exact rank equivalence imposed.
notes.manas-2010:p0144:b002:l038: мөрүн retained mörün, the foreign word for horse used to mark Oshpur’s Kalmyk identity.
notes.manas-2010:p0144:b002:l045: кылча кырың interpreted slightest weakness/opening; precise idiom uncertain.
notes.manas-2010:p0145:b002:l018: биріңди visible singular one of you; collective you beginning Akbaltay is contextual and uncertain.
notes.manas-2010:p0145:b002:l023: Zulpukor retained sword name/type, related to Zulfiqar; no claim that it is historically Ali’s identical sword.
notes.manas-2010:p0145:b002:l025: Compressed contrast understood as not merely Kalmyks but Esenkan; sentence completion crosses three display rows.
notes.manas-2010:p0145:b002:l028: буурсун plow/plow beam; generic plow selected.
notes.manas-2010:p0145:b002:l037: Question about entering khan’s gate retained without supplying invented diplomatic rescue mechanism.
notes.manas-2010:p0146:b002:l026: битте here castrate, not delouse; matching formula confirmed in https://el-sozduk.kg/түрк/.
notes.manas-2010:p0146:b002:l027: түрк means large/fat sheep, confirmed exact epic formula in Yudakhin and 2015 explanatory dictionary. Corrected initial barren draft to fat. https://el-sozduk.kg/түрк/.
notes.manas-2010:p0146:b002:l031: алыңдын has unexpected case; your strength selected without silent source repair.
notes.manas-2010:p0146:b002:l033: өткөрө rendered above all; precise adverbial sense provisional.
notes.manas-2010:p0147:b002:l017: Мал кунду interpreted stock-greedy, also varying күндү at p148:l044; raw variants preserved.
notes.manas-2010:p0147:b002:l042: мазар shrine/sacred place, not necessarily grave; supernatural shrine arising retained.
notes.manas-2010:p0148:b002:l002: ordo is traditional knucklebone game; name retained, not palace in this playing context.
notes.manas-2010:p0148:b002:l008: Мустайыптар retained Mustayyp spirits, likely supernatural protectors; direct dictionary lookup failed, identification unverified.
notes.manas-2010:p0148:b002:l013: Kydyr Niyaz retains both visible name components; may be paired divine figures or formula, not resolved as historical personal name.
notes.manas-2010:p0148:b002:l017: мүчөл could be bodily aspect or twelve-year age cycle; aspects selected from tiger description, uncertainty preserved in note.
notes.manas-2010:p0148:b002:l021: чолок may short-tailed or maimed; short-tailed chosen for lion formula without specifying injury.
notes.manas-2010:p0148:b002:l023: Зымырык retained Zymyryk, mythic bird; no modern bird species imposed.
notes.manas-2010:p0148:b002:l024: Object of snatching not explicit; him supplied provisionally, could be an enemy rather than Manas.
notes.manas-2010:p0148:b002:l026: бир тогуз literally one nine retained as set of nine protectors; identity/count not reconciled with forty chiltens.
notes.manas-2010:p0148:b002:l027: Коржоктотуп looming/mighty appearance is contextual and uncertain.
notes.manas-2010:p0148:b002:l048: Керденге бүткөн born for ruin is provisional curse; precise керден reading unresolved.
notes.manas-2010:p0149:b002:l003: Жоо ээлеген held by enemy retained although sheep are Jakyp’s; no correction to a different verb.
notes.manas-2010:p0149:b002:l010: чунайып interpreted small upright stance, exact posture uncertain.
notes.manas-2010:p0149:b002:l011: Jakyp rejoicing retained despite anger before and after; no smoothing.
notes.manas-2010:p0149:b004:l006: касаба banner verified Yudakhin; ай read moon crest provisionally. https://el-sozduk.kg/касаба/.
notes.manas-2010:p0149:b004:l015: Бурулбаган literally not turned retained; grazing without restraint possible.
notes.manas-2010:p0149:b004:l020: Кочку treated as named champion Kochku in this episode, not translated as village headman; title/name overlap possible.
notes.manas-2010:p0150:b002:l017: Алеңгир great/mighty bow is provisional; сыр rendered lacquered, no invented mechanics.
notes.manas-2010:p0150:b002:l023: мурут literally mustache retained, possible faulty бурут. кызыталак functional abuse bastard, not literal genealogy.
notes.manas-2010:p0150:b002:l025: Баашалыктай interpreted like royalty/king, visible form preserved.
notes.manas-2010:p0150:b002:l033: бепбелен unresolved form; rage with boundless tyranny is contextual from опсуз өкүм, no pretended verified lexical equivalent. Lookup failed.
notes.manas-2010:p0150:b002:l042: кээңди interpreted spite/resentment, possible defect; raw preserved.
notes.manas-2010:p0151:b002:l006: Repeated умачтай көзү ачылуу idiom rendered eyes open wide, consistent earlier batch.
notes.manas-2010:p0151:b002:l009: бокчо bundle retained; not confused with бок, shit.
notes.manas-2010:p0151:b002:l011: улук мунум bar authority formula uncertain; this authority contextual.
notes.manas-2010:p0151:b002:l012: kalday retained imperial official title, no exact modern office asserted.
notes.manas-2010:p0151:b002:l027: дүмпөк foolish/simpleton understood in insulting address, exact nuance provisional.
notes.manas-2010:p0151:b002:l029: элиңе your people retained though speaker means exile region; no change to our people.
notes.manas-2010:p0151:b002:l037: Ашкере open/apparent rendered literally, likely defective or obscure qualification of Burut homeland.
notes.manas-2010:p0152:b002:l001: чени could mean measure/degree; order is contextual in edict passage, reading uncertain.
notes.manas-2010:p0152:b002:l032: чыңыроон retained generically as ringing instrument; precise gong/cymbal/bell identification not verified.
notes.manas-2010:p0152:b002:l035: тыйпыл interpreted completely/all in gathering context, uncertain form.
notes.manas-2010:p0152:b002:l040: Тагылык retained Tagylyk as second envoy’s name; no biographical identification.
notes.manas-2010:p0153:b002:l011: Каяшаяк read answer back from каяша, consistent earlier occurrence; raw preserved.
notes.manas-2010:p0153:b002:l035: Sword without sheath retained exactly, no repair to girding contradiction.
notes.manas-2010:p0153:b002:l045: күлжүктөшүп interpreted clash/grapple; morphology uncertain, compare following кулжуңдашып.
notes.manas-2010:p0154:b002:l006: Даңгыттар retained Danggyts, ethnonym; no modern group identification imposed. жарайын prove myself is provisional.
notes.manas-2010:p0154:b002:l020: Unborn/sinking self-curse preserved; literal contradiction with living speaker not normalized.
notes.manas-2010:p0154:b002:l032: Drawing a line retained as conflict idiom; exact legal/challenge nuance uncertain.
notes.manas-2010:p0154:b002:l035: Past-form burning phrase interpreted curse may he burn to death, consistent earlier passage.
notes.manas-2010:p0154:b002:l043: зордуктап can include coercion, assault or rape; violating chosen to retain breadth, not assert specific sexual incident.
notes.manas-2010:p0155:b002:l004: Тобокел risk/entrustment formula rendered entrusting to God in battle context; explicit God supplied idiomatically.
notes.manas-2010:p0155:b002:l011: күбө protective armor, generic armor chosen; no unsupported metal/material detail.
notes.manas-2010:p0155:b002:l024: каркыбар valiant/dear one, not animal name. Verified Yudakhin and 2015 dictionary https://el-sozduk.kg/каркыбар/.
notes.manas-2010:p0155:b002:l029: Source Адам, Шай punctuation retained in interpretation as man supported by Shay; possible proper-name/formula unresolved.
notes.manas-2010:p0155:b002:l040: Repeated one nine preserved, no invented identities of nine protectors.
notes.manas-2010:p0156:b002:l014: зардал leader, confirmed Yudakhin and 2015 explanatory dictionary with matching formula: https://el-sozduk.kg/зардал/.
notes.manas-2010:p0156:b002:l020: Seven gates retained as epic Beijing description, not claim about modern city geography.
notes.manas-2010:p0156:b002:l031: Жалаяк wide mouth provisional; cliff-brow image retained.
notes.manas-2010:p0156:b002:l032: Oiled-wheat complexion simile retained literally, no ethnic inference.
notes.manas-2010:p0157:b002:l018: кийик wild ungulate; goat selected from stone-climbing context, zoological specificity provisional.
notes.manas-2010:p0157:b002:l021: оорук interpreted army baggage/rear train; precise travel context provisional.
notes.manas-2010:p0157:b002:l024: кара байыр казанат hardy well-bred horse, consistent prior batch; horse-category distinction remains provisional.
notes.manas-2010:p0157:b002:l029: As if rider had died retained despite rider alive, no replacement by common battle simile.
notes.manas-2010:p0157:b002:l031: даңкан clods thrown up by horse hooves, verified Yudakhin and explanatory dictionaries https://el-sozduk.kg/даңкан/. Hut-scale hyperbole retained.
notes.manas-2010:p0157:b002:l034: Sheep flesh simile retained despite uncertain equine conformation idiom.
notes.manas-2010:p0157:b002:l042: комокой thickened iron spear socket where shaft joins, verified https://el-sozduk.kg/комокой/. Socketed is concise provisional rendering.
notes.manas-2010:p0157:b002:l045: Opening armpit literally; open guard selected combat idiom, not literal undressing.
notes.manas-2010:p0158:b002:l012: Күймө read jacket from repeated күрмө formula; visible spelling unchanged, contextual correction explicit.
notes.manas-2010:p0158:b002:l015: Repeated seven hundred total preserved with twelve struck down per attack; no rationalization of counts.
notes.manas-2010:p0158:b002:l030: Slaughtered all retained even though Kochku remains active immediately afterward; no smoothing narrative hyperbole.
notes.manas-2010:p0158:b002:l039: Чын true retained rather than silently changing to сыр lacquered.
notes.manas-2010:p0158:b002:l042: Мөндүлөп battle cry retained Möndü, referent/translation not established.
notes.manas-2010:p0158:b002:l048: Жан казандай great cauldron is provisional, possibly defective чоң казандай. Raw preserved.

raw: Калмактын Кочку балбаны жети жүз кол менен жер коруп келип,
Манаска катылып, Манас аларды такыр кырганы
headings.translation: The Kalmyk champion Kochku comes with seven hundred troops to guard the land, attacks Manas, and Manas slaughters them all.
headings.authorship: unverified; visually set as bold editorial section summary
